prompts.shaman: Create a production 2D game sprite animation sheet for a fantasy forest action platformer. ONE character: SPORELAMP SHAMAN, a small hostile walking mushroom spirit. Broad dark plum mushroom cap with amber bioluminescent gills, pale cream stout stalk body, bark robe and two twig legs, holding a crooked wooden seedpod lantern staff in both root hands. Memorable readable mushroom silhouette, not a human wizard. Painterly 2.5D with crisp sculptural silhouettes, broad shaded forms, restrained surface detail, warm upper-left light; matching a misty blue forest game with painted green leaf-armored hunters. Not pixel art, not photoreal. Side view with slight three-quarter depth, ALWAYS FACING LEFT, whole creature and staff inside each cell. Consistent anatomical size and identity. EXACTLY EIGHT isolated poses on a regular FOUR COLUMN by TWO ROW grid, equal cells with generous transparent gutters, no overlap. Row 1: idle staff held ahead; walk contact left foot forward; walk passing; opposite walking contact. Row 2: staff drawn up in preparation; compressed concentrated spell charging stance; explosive casting thrust staff left; recoil hurt crouch. Match baseline and scale inside each cell. Wide 2:1 sheet, 2048x1024 if possible. True transparent background alpha. No ground plane, cast shadows, scenery, clouds, particles, light effects, text, labels, grid, guides, borders, watermarks or additional characters.
prompts.raven: Create a production 2D game sprite animation sheet for a fantasy forest action platformer. ONE character: NIGHTPLUME RAVEN, a hostile airborne raven with midnight navy feathers, bone-white face markings like a natural narrow mask, silver-cyan wing feather tips, piercing warm amber eyes, hooked dark beak and two sharp talons. Clear raven anatomy and silhouette, not humanoid, not cute mascot. Painterly 2.5D with crisp sculptural silhouettes, broad shaded forms, restrained surface detail and warm upper-left lighting; matching a misty blue forest game with painted leaf-armored hunters. Not pixel art, not photoreal. Side view with slight three-quarter depth, ALWAYS FACING LEFT. Entire bird including wings inside each cell with generous margins. Consistent anatomical proportions and identity. EXACTLY EIGHT isolated poses on a regular FOUR COLUMN by TWO ROW grid, equal cells, no overlap. Row 1: hovering wings fully raised; hover wings midway down; hover wings fully lowered; hover wings midway raised. Row 2: wings swept high preparing to strike; wings folding close, beak angled down-left; fast diagonal down-left dive with wings swept tightly back and talons extended; braking recoil with wings spread and talons forward. Keep body's anatomical size consistent and body center at same place per cell. Wide 2:1 sheet, 2048x1024 if possible. True transparent background alpha. No scenery, ground plane, shadows, motion streaks, glow effects, particles, text, labels, grid, guides, borders, watermarks or other characters.
prompts.beetle: Painterly 2.5D Thornback beetle, moss green leaf-shaped chitin, brass gold horn, ivory lower armor, amber eyes and dark thorn ridges. Side view always facing left. 8 poses regular 4 columns x 2 rows: idle, walk contact, passing, brace; lowered anticipation, explosive charge, extended charge, hurt recoil. Consistent size and foot baseline. Transparent alpha, no scenery, effects, shadows, text or guides.
